Possibly because we included extra spaces or newline? Must be exactly:

<thought>...</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{...}</action_input>

Make sure no extra characters. Let's try again with minimal fields: molecule_smiles, functional_groups_broken, functional_groups_formed, limit.
